summary: End reconcile continuation wakes when the pass itself makes no writes, even under unrelated claim traffic

schema.detail: Uses the existing thread-local changed-row counter.

rules.detail: Reconcile decisions, authority and transaction boundaries are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Continuation passes follow this pass's own writes, not the global store index. External writers keep their notification behavior. The bounded st.reconcile.passes_per_wake histogram reports completed passes using the existing cause registry; span names are unchanged.

recovery.detail: The existing 64-pass cap, self-notify and failure recovery remain in place for passes that write.
